sv.title: Nya Arctic-chefens känga mot DNB Carnegie
sv.summary: Den norska finansfirman Arctic fortsätter satsa i Sverige och nu har den nya landschefen från konkurrenten DNB Carnegie börjat, med höga rekryteringsambitioner.

en.title: New Arctic chief's jab at DNB Carnegie
en.summary: The Norwegian financial firm Arctic continues to invest in Sweden, and now its new country head, who came from rival DNB Carnegie, has started with high recruitment ambitions.
